The L-1 visa allows employers to transfer employees from their foreign offices to their U.S. offices while continuing to pay them the same salaries they earned abroad. There are no quotas, no labor condition requirements, and no wage standards. Their spouses can also work.

@SenFettermanPA says Israel has done nothing wrong, calling its actions “necessary” to destroy Hamas, Hezbollah, and confront Iran—while describing those groups as incapable of anything but terror.

And he leaves no ambiguity:

“If you want to criticize someone… criticize Iran, criticize Hamas, criticize Hezbollah.”

“We are the force of good… as Israel is.”

🚨Republicans are getting a clear warning ahead of the midterms.

@LisaMarieBoothe says ideas once considered fringe are now winning in places like New Jersey’s 11th—a suburban district, not a progressive stronghold.

She points to a troubling trend:

“These ideas are becoming more mainstream… that’s the danger.”

And warns what’s coming:

“Democrats have the clear momentum.”

“This could be a bad election cycle… if we don’t get motivated.”

Video

🚨This is a blunt rebuke of how Democrats have handled immigration.

@SenFettermanPA goes straight at sanctuary policies, calling it “outrageous” that dangerous criminals aren’t turned over, and arguing it’s just “basic common sense” to “secure our border” and “deport all the criminals.”

Then he delivers the blunt conclusion:

“We became the party of open borders.”

Video

@SenFettermanPA lays it out on #Israel:

“80% of Democrats view Israel in a negative light.”

“That’s where my party’s at.”

“To pulverize the Iranian military… eliminating their leadership is a strong development.”

We need to see a return to peace and stability, and a permanent ceasefire.
